cases.name: strict: replacement before importing codecs retains the published builtin
cases.source:
import _codecs
original = _codecs.lookup_error('strict')
events = []
def replacement(error):
    events.append(error)
    return ('replacement', error.end)
_codecs.register_error('strict', replacement)
import codecs
assert codecs.strict_errors is original
assert codecs.lookup_error('strict') is replacement
assert codecs.lookup_error('strict') is _codecs.lookup_error('strict')
failure = UnicodeEncodeError('ascii', 'é', 0, 1, 'unencodable')
assert codecs.lookup_error('strict')(failure) == ('replacement', 1)
assert events == [failure]
_codecs.register_error('strict', original)
assert codecs.lookup_error('strict') is original
assert codecs.strict_errors is original
